subject: Animation
title: From Zoetrope to AI: Animation's Tech Journey
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: From Zoetrope to AI: Animation's Tech Journey.

hook.text: Animation technology has leapt from spinning drums to hand-drawn cels to CGI to AI in just 150 years.

buildup.text: Each technological shift made animation faster, cheaper, and more accessible — but also displaced skilled workers.

discovery.text: Every new tool was initially feared. Cel animation was mocked. CGI was dismissed. Each became the new standard.

twist.text: Despite every technological revolution, the core challenge remains the same: making audiences feel something.

climax.text: Technology changes constantly, but animation's purpose has not changed since the first cave drawing flickered.

punchline.text: The tools keep changing. The goal — making people feel — never does.

quiz.question: What has remained constant throughout animation's technological evolution?
options: The specific tools and techniques used by animators
The core purpose of making audiences feel emotion, regardless of the technology used
The number of frames per second in animated films
